QUOTE: The ref is not attached to the title header or the large title. It is forwarded only into `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />`, which renders only when `hasSearch` is true (lines 128–138). ... If `hasSearch` is false, the ref is silently dropped, because `NavigationSearch` is never rendered.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, which renders only when hasSearch is true, and that the ref is otherwise dropped, attached to nothing.
